sanskrit: praty u̍ adarśy āya̱ty u1̱̍cchantī̍ duhi̱tā di̱vaḥ | apo̱ mahi̍ vyayati̱ cakṣa̍se̱ tamo̱ jyoti̍ṣ kṛṇoti sū̱narī̍ ||
english: She is seen coming forth, the Daughter of Heaven as she rises; she spreads the great waters wide for sight to behold, the gracious one makes light and dispels the darkness.

sanskrit: ud u̱sriyā̍ḥ sṛjate̱ sūrya̱ḥ sacā̍m̐ u̱dyan nakṣa̍tram arci̱vat | taved u̍ṣo̱ vyuṣi̱ sūrya̍sya ca̱ sam bha̱ktena̍ gamemahi ||
english: The Sun releases the ruddy cows together as he rises, bright like a burning star. At thy dawning, O Uṣas, and at the arising of the Sun, may we come together to share in our allotted portion.

sanskrit: prati̍ tvā duhitar diva̱ uṣo̍ jī̱rā a̍bhutsmahi | yā vaha̍si pu̱ru spā̱rhaṁ va̍nanvati̱ ratna̱ṁ na dā̱śuṣe̱ maya̍ḥ ||
english: We, alert and eager, have greeted thee, O Uṣas, Daughter of Heaven; who, all-triumphant, bringest many things worthy of desire — joy as a jewel to the worshipper.

sanskrit: u̱cchantī̱ yā kṛ̱ṇoṣi̍ ma̱ṁhanā̍ mahi pra̱khyai de̍vi̱ sva̍r dṛ̱śe | tasyā̍s te ratna̱bhāja̍ īmahe va̱yaṁ syāma̍ mā̱tur na sū̱nava̍ḥ ||
english: She who, rising, with her greatness illumines all for sight, O Goddess, that heaven's brilliance may be seen — may we be sharers in her treasure, as sons are in their mother's.

sanskrit: tac ci̱traṁ rādha̱ ā bha̱roṣo̱ yad dī̍rgha̱śrutta̍mam | yat te̍ divo duhitar marta̱bhoja̍na̱ṁ tad rā̍sva bhu̱najā̍mahai ||
english: Bring that wondrous, most far-famed bounty, O Uṣas; that portion for mortals which belongs to thee, O Daughter of Heaven — bestow it, and let us partake of it.

sanskrit: śrava̍ḥ sū̱ribhyo̍ a̱mṛta̍ṁ vasutva̱naṁ vājā̍m̐ a̱smabhya̱ṁ goma̍taḥ | co̱da̱yi̱trī ma̱ghona̍ḥ sū̱nṛtā̍vaty u̱ṣā u̍ccha̱d apa̱ sridha̍ḥ ||
english: Fame, immortality, wealth of possessions, prizes rich in cattle — bestow these upon the liberal lords, upon us. May Uṣas, the rouser of the bountiful, rich in true speech, shine forth and drive away all foes.

sanskrit: indrā̍varuṇā yu̱vam a̍dhva̱rāya̍ no vi̱śe janā̍ya̱ mahi̱ śarma̍ yacchatam | dī̱rghapra̍yajyu̱m ati̱ yo va̍nu̱ṣyati̍ va̱yaṁ ja̍yema̱ pṛta̍nāsu dū̱ḍhya̍ḥ ||
english: O Indra and Varuṇa, grant great shelter to our people for the sacrifice. May we conquer in battles the obstinate foe who seeks to overcome him long-lauded in prayer.

sanskrit: sa̱mrāḻ a̱nyaḥ sva̱rāḻ a̱nya u̍cyate vām ma̱hāntā̱v indrā̱varu̍ṇā ma̱hāva̍sū | viśve̍ de̱vāsa̍ḥ para̱me vyo̍mani̱ saṁ vā̱m ojo̍ vṛṣaṇā̱ sam bala̍ṁ dadhuḥ ||
english: One of you is called Samrāj, the other Svarāj; both are great — Indra and Varuṇa, great in wealth. All the gods in the highest heaven have joined together your strength and your might, O you two bulls.

sanskrit: anv a̱pāṁ khāny a̍tṛnta̱m oja̱sā sūrya̍m airayataṁ di̱vi pra̱bhum | indrā̍varuṇā̱ made̍ asya mā̱yino 'pi̍nvatam a̱pita̱ḥ pinva̍ta̱ṁ dhiya̍ḥ ||
english: With your power you clove open the channels of the waters; you drove the Sun, the lord, aloft in the sky. O Indra and Varuṇa, in the exhilaration of this sage's soma, speed his unimpeded thoughts; let his prayers flow freely.

sanskrit: yu̱vām id yu̱tsu pṛta̍nāsu̱ vahna̍yo yu̱vāṁ kṣema̍sya prasa̱ve mi̱tajña̍vaḥ | ī̱śā̱nā vasva̍ u̱bhaya̍sya kā̱rava̱ indrā̍varuṇā su̱havā̍ havāmahe ||
english: You alone are the bearers in battles and in wars; you two are wisely known at the impelling of prosperity. Lords of both kinds of wealth, you craftsmen — O Indra and Varuṇa, easy to invoke, we call upon you.

sanskrit: indrā̍varuṇā̱ yad i̱māni̍ ca̱krathu̱r viśvā̍ jā̱tāni̱ bhuva̍nasya ma̱jmanā̍ | kṣeme̍ṇa mi̱tro varu̍ṇaṁ duva̱syati̍ ma̱rudbhi̍r u̱graḥ śubha̍m a̱nya ī̍yate ||
english: O Indra and Varuṇa, when you by your greatness made all these creatures of the universe — Mitra serves Varuṇa with security, and the other, the mighty one, goes in glory with the Maruts.

sanskrit: ma̱he śu̱lkāya̱ varu̍ṇasya̱ nu tvi̱ṣa ojo̍ mimāte dhru̱vam a̍sya̱ yat svam | ajā̍mim a̱nyaḥ śna̱thaya̍nta̱m āti̍rad da̱bhrebhi̍r a̱nyaḥ pra vṛ̍ṇoti̱ bhūya̍saḥ ||
english: For Varuṇa's great tribute the splendour and fixed might which is his own are measured out. The one transcends the unrestrained assailant; with little he makes the other choose the many.

sanskrit: na tam aṁho̱ na du̍ri̱tāni̱ martya̱m indrā̍varuṇā̱ na tapa̱ḥ kuta̍ś ca̱na | yasya̍ devā̱ gaccha̍tho vī̱tho a̍dhva̱raṁ na tam marta̍sya naśate̱ pari̍hvṛtiḥ ||
english: No anguish, no evil deeds, no torment from any quarter can reach that mortal, O Indra and Varuṇa, to whose sacrifice you two go and feast. No mortal's affliction can overtake him.

sanskrit: a̱rvāṅ na̍rā̱ daivye̱nāva̱sā ga̍taṁ śṛṇu̱taṁ hava̱ṁ yadi̍ me̱ jujo̍ṣathaḥ | yu̱vor hi sa̱khyam u̱ta vā̱ yad āpya̍m mārḍī̱kam i̍ndrāvaruṇā̱ ni ya̍cchatam ||
english: Come hither, O heroes, with divine protection; hear my call if you take pleasure in it. Grant us, O Indra and Varuṇa, that friendship of yours, or that alliance — your gracious favour.

sanskrit: a̱smāka̍m indrāvaruṇā̱ bhare̍-bhare puroyo̱dhā bha̍vataṁ kṛṣṭyojasā | yad vā̱ṁ hava̍nta u̱bhaye̱ adha̍ spṛ̱dhi nara̍s to̱kasya̱ tana̍yasya sā̱tiṣu̍ ||
english: Be our vanguard fighters in every contest, O Indra and Varuṇa, with the strength of your peoples. When men on both sides call upon you in the contest, in the battles for offspring and descendants.

sanskrit: a̱sme indro̱ varu̍ṇo mi̱tro a̍rya̱mā dyu̱mnaṁ ya̍cchantu̱ mahi̱ śarma̍ sa̱pratha̍ḥ | a̱va̱dhraṁ jyoti̱r adi̍ter ṛtā̱vṛdho̍ de̱vasya̱ śloka̍ṁ savi̱tur ma̍nāmahe ||
english: May Indra, Varuṇa, Mitra, and Aryaman grant us radiance and great far-spreading shelter. We meditate upon the unfailing light of Aditi that augments holy order, and upon the glorifying word of the god Savitṛ.

sanskrit: yu̱vāṁ na̍rā̱ paśya̍mānāsa̱ āpya̍m prā̱cā ga̱vyanta̍ḥ pṛthu̱parśa̍vo yayuḥ | dāsā̍ ca vṛ̱trā ha̱tam āryā̍ṇi ca su̱dāsa̍m indrāvaru̱ṇāva̍sāvatam ||
english: Gazing upon your alliance and seeking cows, the Pṛthupārśvas went eastward. Slay both the Dāsa and Ārya foes; protect Sudās, O Indra and Varuṇa, with your aid.

sanskrit: yatrā̱ nara̍ḥ sa̱maya̍nte kṛ̱tadhva̍jo̱ yasmi̍nn ā̱jā bhava̍ti̱ kiṁ ca̱na pri̱yam | yatrā̱ bhaya̍nte̱ bhuva̍nā sva̱rdṛśa̱s tatrā̍ na indrāvaru̱ṇādhi̍ vocatam ||
english: Where the banner-bearing warriors come together, where in the contest something dear is won, where the heaven-seeing worlds tremble with fear — there speak on our behalf, O Indra and Varuṇa.

sanskrit: sam bhūmyā̱ antā̍ dhvasi̱rā a̍dṛkṣa̱tendrā̍varuṇā di̱vi ghoṣa̱ āru̍hat | asthu̱r janā̍nā̱m upa̱ mām arā̍tayo̱ 'rvāg ava̍sā havanaśru̱tā ga̍tam ||
english: The brilliant ends of earth were seen together; the battle-cry rose to heaven, O Indra and Varuṇa. Enemies of the peoples have stood against me — come hither with protection, ye who hear our call.

sanskrit: indrā̍varuṇā va̱dhanā̍bhir apra̱ti bhe̱daṁ va̱nvantā̱ pra su̱dāsa̍m āvatam | brahmā̍ṇy eṣāṁ śṛṇuta̱ṁ havī̍mani sa̱tyā tṛtsū̍nām abhavat pu̱rohi̍tiḥ ||
english: O Indra and Varuṇa, winning an irresistible breakthrough with your weapons, protect Sudās. Hear the prayers of these men along with their oblations; true was the office of the Tṛtsus' priest.

sanskrit: indrā̍varuṇāv a̱bhy ā ta̍panti mā̱ghāny a̱ryo va̱nuṣā̱m arā̍tayaḥ | yu̱vaṁ hi vasva̍ u̱bhaya̍sya̱ rāja̱tho 'dha̍ smā no 'vata̱m pārye̍ di̱vi ||
english: The hostile enemies of the noble one press upon him with their spells, O Indra and Varuṇa. You two are kings of both kinds of wealth — therefore protect us in the supreme heaven.

sanskrit: yu̱vāṁ ha̍vanta u̱bhayā̍sa ā̱jiṣv indra̍ṁ ca̱ vasvo̱ varu̍ṇaṁ ca sā̱taye̍ | yatra̱ rāja̍bhir da̱śabhi̱r nibā̍dhita̱m pra su̱dāsa̱m āva̍ta̱ṁ tṛtsu̍bhiḥ sa̱ha ||
english: Both parties called upon you in the contests — Indra and Varuṇa — for the winning of wealth. Where he was pressed hard by ten kings, protect Sudās together with the Tṛtsus.

sanskrit: daśa̱ rājā̍na̱ḥ sami̍tā̱ aya̍jyavaḥ su̱dāsa̍m indrāvaruṇā̱ na yu̍yudhuḥ | sa̱tyā nṛ̱ṇām a̍dma̱sadā̱m upa̍stutir de̱vā e̍ṣām abhavan de̱vahū̍tiṣu ||
english: Ten kings assembled, offering no sacrifice, yet could not vanquish Sudās, O Indra and Varuṇa. True was the praise of the table-companions among men; the gods were theirs at their invocations of the gods.

sanskrit: dā̱śa̱rā̱jñe pari̍yattāya vi̱śvata̍ḥ su̱dāsa̍ indrāvaruṇāv aśikṣatam | śvi̱tyañco̱ yatra̱ nama̍sā kapa̱rdino̍ dhi̱yā dhīva̍nto̱ asa̍panta̱ tṛtsa̍vaḥ ||
english: In the Battle of the Ten Kings, when all pressed round, Indra and Varuṇa aided Sudās. Where the Tṛtsus, white-robed and knotted-haired, devout in thought and rich in prayer, spread out with homage.

sanskrit: vṛ̱trāṇy a̱nyaḥ sa̍mi̱theṣu̱ jighna̍te vra̱tāny a̱nyo a̱bhi ra̍kṣate̱ sadā̍ | havā̍mahe vāṁ vṛṣaṇā suvṛ̱ktibhi̍r a̱sme i̍ndrāvaruṇā̱ śarma̍ yacchatam ||
english: One of you smites the foes in battles; the other protects the sacred ordinances for ever. We invoke you both, O mighty bulls, with well-fashioned praises — grant us shelter, O Indra and Varuṇa.

sanskrit: a̱sme indro̱ varu̍ṇo mi̱tro a̍rya̱mā dyu̱mnaṁ ya̍cchantu̱ mahi̱ śarma̍ sa̱pratha̍ḥ | a̱va̱dhraṁ jyoti̱r adi̍ter ṛtā̱vṛdho̍ de̱vasya̱ śloka̍ṁ savi̱tur ma̍nāmahe ||
english: May Indra, Varuṇa, Mitra, and Aryaman grant us radiance and great far-spreading shelter. We meditate upon the unfailing light of Aditi that augments holy order, and upon the glorifying word of the god Savitṛ.

sanskrit: ā vā̍ṁ rājānāv adhva̱re va̍vṛtyāṁ ha̱vyebhi̍r indrāvaruṇā̱ namo̍bhiḥ | pra vā̍ṁ ghṛ̱tācī̍ bā̱hvor dadhā̍nā̱ pari̱ tmanā̱ viṣu̍rūpā jigāti ||
english: I would turn you two kings toward our sacrifice with oblations and acts of reverence, O Indra and Varuṇa. She who holds clarified butter in her two arms, manifold in form, courses around of her own accord.

sanskrit: yu̱vo rā̱ṣṭram bṛ̱had i̍nvati̱ dyaur yau se̱tṛbhi̍r ara̱jjubhi̍ḥ sinī̱thaḥ | pari̍ no̱ heḻo̱ varu̍ṇasya vṛjyā u̱ruṁ na̱ indra̍ḥ kṛṇavad u lo̱kam ||
english: Heaven quickens your great sovereignty, you who bind with bands without a cord. May we be turned aside from Varuṇa's wrath; may Indra make a wide space for us.

sanskrit: kṛ̱taṁ no̍ ya̱jñaṁ vi̱dathe̍ṣu̱ cāru̍ṁ kṛ̱tam brahmā̍ṇi sū̱riṣu̍ praśa̱stā | upo̍ ra̱yir de̱vajū̍to na etu̱ pra ṇa̍ḥ spā̱rhābhi̍r ū̱tibhi̍s tiretam ||
english: Make our sacrifice beautiful in the assemblies, make our prayers celebrated among the patrons of worship. Let god-sped wealth come near us; lead us forward with your longed-for aids.

sanskrit: a̱sme i̍ndrāvaruṇā vi̱śvavā̍raṁ ra̱yiṁ dha̍tta̱ṁ vasu̍mantam puru̱kṣum | pra ya ā̍di̱tyo anṛ̍tā mi̱nāty ami̍tā̱ śūro̍ dayate̱ vasū̍ni ||
english: Grant to us, O Indra and Varuṇa, a wealth all-excellent, rich in substance, abounding in plenty. The Āditya destroys those who transgress his ordinances; the immeasurable hero shares out his goods.

sanskrit: i̱yam indra̱ṁ varu̍ṇam aṣṭa me̱ gīḥ prāva̍t to̱ke tana̍ye̱ tūtu̍jānā | su̱ratnā̍so de̱vavī̍tiṁ gamema yū̱yam pā̍ta sva̱stibhi̱ḥ sadā̍ naḥ ||
english: This my hymn has reached Indra and Varuṇa; rushing swiftly it has helped in progeny and offspring. Possessed of good treasure may we come to the feast of the gods. Preserve us evermore with your blessings.

sanskrit: pu̱nī̱ṣe vā̍m ara̱kṣasa̍m manī̱ṣāṁ soma̱m indrā̍ya̱ varu̍ṇāya̱ juhva̍t | ghṛ̱tapra̍tīkām u̱ṣasa̱ṁ na de̱vīṁ tā no̱ yāma̍nn uruṣyatām a̱bhīke̍ ||
english: I purify for you both a demon-free prayer, pouring out soma for Indra and for Varuṇa. Like a goddess whose face is clarified butter — like Uṣas — may those two protect us on our path in the encounter.

sanskrit: spardha̍nte̱ vā u̍ deva̱hūye̱ atra̱ yeṣu̍ dhva̱jeṣu̍ di̱dyava̱ḥ pata̍nti | yu̱vaṁ tām̐ i̍ndrāvaruṇāv a̱mitrā̍n ha̱tam parā̍ca̱ḥ śarvā̱ viṣū̍caḥ ||
english: They indeed compete at this invocation of the gods, those upon whose banners the lightning-bolts fall. Smite those enemies, O Indra and Varuṇa, with your arrows, scattering them in all directions.

sanskrit: āpa̍ś ci̱d dhi svaya̍śasa̱ḥ sada̍ḥsu de̱vīr indra̱ṁ varu̍ṇaṁ de̱vatā̱ dhuḥ | kṛ̱ṣṭīr a̱nyo dhā̱raya̍ti̱ pravi̍ktā vṛ̱trāṇy a̱nyo a̍pra̱tīni̍ hanti ||
english: Even the self-luminous divine Waters at their seats have held Indra and Varuṇa as their deity. The one sustains the peoples spread apart; the other smites foes that cannot be withstood.

sanskrit: sa su̱kratu̍r ṛta̱cid a̍stu̱ hotā̱ ya ā̍ditya̱ śava̍sā vā̱ṁ nama̍svān | ā̱va̱varta̱d ava̍se vāṁ ha̱viṣmā̱n asa̱d it sa su̍vi̱tāya̱ praya̍svān ||
english: Let him be a wise-minded, truth-knowing hotar, who O Ādityas, reverently approaches you with your strength. The one who has turned to you for aid with oblations — let him indeed be endowed with prosperity.

sanskrit: i̱yam indra̱ṁ varu̍ṇam aṣṭa me̱ gīḥ prāva̍t to̱ke tana̍ye̱ tūtu̍jānā | su̱ratnā̍so de̱vavī̍tiṁ gamema yū̱yam pā̍ta sva̱stibhi̱ḥ sadā̍ naḥ ||
english: This my hymn has reached Indra and Varuṇa; rushing swiftly it has helped in progeny and offspring. Possessed of good treasure may we come to the feast of the gods. Preserve us evermore with your blessings.

sanskrit: dhīrā̱ tv a̍sya mahi̱nā ja̱nūṁṣi̱ vi yas ta̱stambha̱ roda̍sī cid u̱rvī | pra nāka̍m ṛ̱ṣvaṁ nu̍nude bṛ̱hanta̍ṁ dvi̱tā nakṣa̍tram pa̱pratha̍c ca̱ bhūma̍ ||
english: The wise know well by his greatness — he who propped asunder the two great worlds, heaven and earth. He thrust high and aloft the lofty vault of heaven; he spread out the starry firmament on two sides, and the earth too.

sanskrit: u̱ta svayā̍ ta̱nvā̱3̱̍ saṁ va̍de̱ tat ka̱dā nv a1̱̍ntar varu̍ṇe bhuvāni | kim me̍ ha̱vyam ahṛ̍ṇāno juṣeta ka̱dā mṛ̍ḻī̱kaṁ su̱manā̍ a̱bhi khya̍m ||
english: I shall commune with my own self about that — when shall I be within Varuṇa's grace? When will he, unangered, enjoy my oblation? When shall I, joyful, behold his mercy?

sanskrit: pṛ̱cche tad eno̍ varuṇa di̱dṛkṣūpo̍ emi ciki̱tuṣo̍ vi̱pṛccha̍m | sa̱mā̱nam in me̍ ka̱vaya̍ś cid āhur a̱yaṁ ha̱ tubhya̱ṁ varu̍ṇo hṛṇīte ||
english: I ask what that sin is, O Varuṇa — longing to see, I come to question the wise. The seers have told me the same thing: 'Varuṇa himself is wrathful toward you.'

sanskrit: kim āga̍ āsa varuṇa̱ jyeṣṭha̱ṁ yat sto̱tāra̱ṁ jighā̍ṁsasi̱ sakhā̍yam | pra tan me̍ voco dūḻabha svadhā̱vo 'va̍ tvāne̱nā nama̍sā tu̱ra i̍yām ||
english: What was the chief transgression, O Varuṇa, that you wish to slay your praising friend? Declare that to me, O hard-to-gain, self-sustaining one; I shall come swiftly to propitiate you with homage, free from this.

sanskrit: ava̍ dru̱gdhāni̱ pitryā̍ sṛjā̱ no 'va̱ yā va̱yaṁ ca̍kṛ̱mā ta̱nūbhi̍ḥ | ava̍ rājan paśu̱tṛpa̱ṁ na tā̱yuṁ sṛ̱jā va̱tsaṁ na dāmno̱ vasi̍ṣṭham ||
english: Release us from the inherited sins of our fathers; release also those which we ourselves have committed in our own bodies. Release, O King, as a thief who has satisfied himself with cattle — release Vasiṣṭha as a calf from a rope.

sanskrit: na sa svo dakṣo̍ varuṇa̱ dhruti̱ḥ sā surā̍ ma̱nyur vi̱bhīda̍ko̱ aci̍ttiḥ | asti̱ jyāyā̱n kanī̍yasa upā̱re svapna̍ś ca̱ned anṛ̍tasya prayo̱tā ||
english: It was not my own will, O Varuṇa; it was intoxication, dice, anger, thoughtlessness. The older one is present near to the younger; even sleep is a promoter of sin.

sanskrit: ara̍ṁ dā̱so na mī̱ḻhuṣe̍ karāṇy a̱haṁ de̱vāya̱ bhūrṇa̱ye 'nā̍gāḥ | ace̍tayad a̱cito̍ de̱vo a̱ryo gṛtsa̍ṁ rā̱ye ka̱vita̍ro junāti ||
english: I shall do service to the bountiful one as a slave, sinless, to the god who is wroth. The noble god has enlightened the unperceiving; the wise one spurs on the inspired to wealth.

sanskrit: a̱yaṁ su tubhya̍ṁ varuṇa svadhāvo hṛ̱di stoma̱ upa̍śritaś cid astu | śaṁ na̱ḥ kṣeme̱ śam u̱ yoge̍ no astu yū̱yam pā̍ta sva̱stibhi̱ḥ sadā̍ naḥ ||
english: May this hymn of praise, O Varuṇa, self-sustaining one, abide well lodged within your heart. May there be welfare for us in repose, and welfare in action. Preserve us evermore with your blessings.

sanskrit: rada̍t pa̱tho varu̍ṇa̱ḥ sūryā̍ya̱ prārṇā̍ṁsi samu̱driyā̍ na̱dīnā̍m | sargo̱ na sṛ̱ṣṭo arva̍tīr ṛtā̱yañ ca̱kāra̍ ma̱hīr a̱vanī̱r aha̍bhyaḥ ||
english: Varuṇa carved out paths for the Sun; he spread out the great flood of the rivers of the sea. Acting in accord with holy order, like a released racehorse, he made the great streams flow for the days.

sanskrit: ā̱tmā te̱ vāto̱ raja̱ ā na̍vīnot pa̱śur na bhūrṇi̱r yava̍se sasa̱vān | a̱ntar ma̱hī bṛ̍ha̱tī roda̍sī̱me viśvā̍ te̱ dhāma̍ varuṇa pri̱yāṇi̍ ||
english: The wind is your breath; it has renewed the realm. Like a restless beast pasturing on the meadow, these two great expanses, the earth and heaven, abide between — all your dear dwelling-places, O Varuṇa.

sanskrit: pari̱ spaśo̱ varu̍ṇasya̱ smadi̍ṣṭā u̱bhe pa̍śyanti̱ roda̍sī su̱meke̍ | ṛ̱tāvā̍naḥ ka̱vayo̍ ya̱jñadhī̍rā̱ḥ prace̍taso̱ ya i̱ṣaya̍nta̱ manma̍ ||
english: Varuṇa's keen-eyed spies look out from both the well-adorned worlds, heaven and earth. The holders of holy order, the seers wise in sacrifice, the far-sighted ones who speed thought forward — they behold.

sanskrit: u̱vāca̍ me̱ varu̍ṇo̱ medhi̍rāya̱ triḥ sa̱pta nāmāghnyā̍ bibharti | vi̱dvān pa̱dasya̱ guhyā̱ na vo̍cad yu̱gāya̱ vipra̱ upa̍rāya̱ śikṣa̍n ||
english: Varuṇa has spoken to me, the wise one; the inviolable cow bears thrice seven names. The knowing one shall not declare the hidden secrets of the track — teaching the inspired poet of the later age.

sanskrit: ti̱sro dyāvo̱ nihi̍tā a̱ntar a̍smin ti̱sro bhūmī̱r upa̍rā̱ḥ ṣaḍvi̍dhānāḥ | gṛtso̱ rājā̱ varu̍ṇaś cakra e̱taṁ di̱vi pre̱ṅkhaṁ hi̍ra̱ṇyaya̍ṁ śu̱bhe kam ||
english: Three heavens are set within him; three earths, the upper ones arranged sixfold. The wise King Varuṇa has made this golden swing in the sky for splendour.

sanskrit: ava̱ sindhu̱ṁ varu̍ṇo̱ dyaur i̍va sthād dra̱pso na śve̱to mṛ̱gas tuvi̍ṣmān | ga̱mbhī̱raśa̍ṁso̱ raja̍so vi̱māna̍ḥ supā̱rakṣa̍traḥ sa̱to a̱sya rājā̍ ||
english: Varuṇa has stood over Sindhu like heaven, like a white drop, a mighty beast. Deep-voiced, he who measures out the realm, the king of all that exists, the lord of good protection.

sanskrit: yo mṛ̱ḻayā̍ti ca̱kruṣe̍ ci̱d āgo̍ va̱yaṁ syā̍ma̱ varu̍ṇe̱ anā̍gāḥ ||  anu̍ vra̱tāny adi̍ter ṛ̱dhanto̍ yū̱yam pā̍ta sva̱stibhi̱ḥ sadā̍ naḥ ||
english: He who shows mercy even to one who has sinned — may we be sinless before Varuṇa. Thriving in accord with the ordinances of Aditi, preserve us evermore with your blessings.

sanskrit: pra śu̱ndhyuva̱ṁ varu̍ṇāya̱ preṣṭhā̍m ma̱tiṁ va̍siṣṭha mī̱ḻhuṣe̍ bharasva | ya ī̍m a̱rvāñca̱ṁ kara̍te̱ yaja̍traṁ sa̱hasrā̍magha̱ṁ vṛṣa̍ṇam bṛ̱hanta̍m ||
english: Purify and bring the most beloved prayer to Varuṇa, O Vasiṣṭha, to the bountiful one — he who makes the worshipful, the thousandfold blessed, the mighty bull turn toward us.

sanskrit: adhā̱ nv a̍sya sa̱ṁdṛśa̍ṁ jaga̱nvān a̱gner anī̍ka̱ṁ varu̍ṇasya maṁsi | sva1̱̍r yad aśma̍nn adhi̱pā u̱ andho̱ 'bhi mā̱ vapu̍r dṛ̱śaye̍ ninīyāt ||
english: Having gone to his sight, I shall contemplate the face of Agni and of Varuṇa. When upon a rock the guardian of heaven's intoxicant would lead my form to see the radiance.

sanskrit: ā yad ru̱hāva̱ varu̍ṇaś ca̱ nāva̱m pra yat sa̍mu̱dram ī̱rayā̍va̱ madhya̍m | adhi̱ yad a̱pāṁ snubhi̱ś carā̍va̱ pra pre̱ṅkha ī̍ṅkhayāvahai śu̱bhe kam ||
english: When Varuṇa and I shall embark upon the boat and drive it out to the middle of the ocean, when we shall roam upon the ridges of the waters — shall we then swing together on the swing for splendour?

sanskrit: vasi̍ṣṭhaṁ ha̱ varu̍ṇo nā̱vy ādhā̱d ṛṣi̍ṁ cakāra̱ svapā̱ maho̍bhiḥ | sto̱tāra̱ṁ vipra̍ḥ sudina̱tve ahnā̱ṁ yān nu dyāva̍s ta̱tana̱n yād u̱ṣāsa̍ḥ ||
english: Varuṇa placed Vasiṣṭha in the boat; by his great deeds he made him a seer, skilled in works. The inspired lord, on the bright days which the heavens have stretched out and which the dawns have stretched, glorified his praiser.

sanskrit: kva1̱̍ tyāni̍ nau sa̱khyā ba̍bhūvu̱ḥ sacā̍vahe̱ yad a̍vṛ̱kam pu̱rā ci̍t | bṛ̱hanta̱m māna̍ṁ varuṇa svadhāvaḥ sa̱hasra̍dvāraṁ jagamā gṛ̱haṁ te̍ ||
english: Where have those friendships of ours gone? We two used to keep companionship without hostility, as in former times. I have entered your great, thousanddoored, self-sustaining house, O Varuṇa.

sanskrit: ya ā̱pir nityo̍ varuṇa pri̱yaḥ san tvām āgā̍ṁsi kṛ̱ṇava̱t sakhā̍ te | mā ta̱ ena̍svanto yakṣin bhujema ya̱ndhi ṣmā̱ vipra̍ḥ stuva̱te varū̍tham ||
english: He who is your eternal companion and dear one, O Varuṇa, yet commits transgressions against you — let us not, being sinful, enjoy your worship, O holy one; give shelter to the poet who praises you.

sanskrit: dhru̱vāsu̍ tvā̱su kṣi̱tiṣu̍ kṣi̱yanto̱ vy a1̱̍smat pāśa̱ṁ varu̍ṇo mumocat | avo̍ vanvā̱nā adi̍ter u̱pasthā̍d yū̱yam pā̍ta sva̱stibhi̱ḥ sadā̍ naḥ ||
english: May Varuṇa release from us the fetters while we dwell in these firm abodes. Winning the favour from the lap of Aditi, preserve us evermore with your blessings.

sanskrit: mo ṣu va̍ruṇa mṛ̱nmaya̍ṁ gṛ̱haṁ rā̍jann a̱haṁ ga̍mam | mṛ̱ḻā su̍kṣatra mṛ̱ḻaya̍ ||
english: May I not go, O King Varuṇa, into the house made of clay. Have mercy, O thou of good dominion, have mercy.

sanskrit: yad emi̍ prasphu̱rann i̍va̱ dṛti̱r na dhmā̱to a̍drivaḥ | mṛ̱ḻā su̍kṣatra mṛ̱ḻaya̍ ||
english: When I go about trembling like an inflated bladder, O lord of the stone-pressing — have mercy, O thou of good dominion, have mercy.

sanskrit: kratva̍ḥ samaha dī̱natā̍ pratī̱paṁ ja̍gamā śuce | mṛ̱ḻā su̍kṣatra mṛ̱ḻaya̍ ||
english: Through lack of strength, O shining one, I have gone against your will in my wretchedness. Have mercy, O thou of good dominion, have mercy.

sanskrit: a̱pām madhye̍ tasthi̱vāṁsa̱ṁ tṛṣṇā̍vidaj jari̱tāra̍m | mṛ̱ḻā su̍kṣatra mṛ̱ḻaya̍ ||
english: Thirst has found the singer standing in the middle of the waters. Have mercy, O thou of good dominion, have mercy.

sanskrit: yat kiṁ ce̱daṁ va̍ruṇa̱ daivye̱ jane̍ 'bhidro̱ham ma̍nu̱ṣyā̱3̱̍ś carā̍masi | aci̍ttī̱ yat tava̱ dharmā̍ yuyopi̱ma mā na̱s tasmā̱d ena̍so deva rīriṣaḥ ||
english: Whatever transgression against the divine order we mortals commit among the divine people, O Varuṇa — whatever of your ordinances we have violated through ignorance — do not injure us for that sin, O God.

sanskrit: pra vī̍ra̱yā śuca̍yo dadrire vām adhva̱ryubhi̱r madhu̍mantaḥ su̱tāsa̍ḥ ||  vaha̍ vāyo ni̱yuto̍ yā̱hy acchā̱ pibā̍ su̱tasyāndha̍so̱ madā̍ya ||
english: The pure soma-draughts, sweet and pressed by the adhvaryus, have been prepared heroically for you two. Come hither with your teams, O Vāyu; drink the pressed soma juice for exhilaration.

sanskrit: ī̱śā̱nāya̱ prahu̍ti̱ṁ yas ta̱ āna̱ṭ chuci̱ṁ soma̍ṁ śucipā̱s tubhya̍ṁ vāyo | kṛ̱ṇoṣi̱ tam martye̍ṣu praśa̱staṁ jā̱to-jā̍to jāyate vā̱jy a̍sya ||
english: He who has made the oblation reach you the master, the pure soma, O pure-drinking Vāyu — you make that man praiseworthy among mortals; again and again a champion is born to him.

sanskrit: rā̱ye nu yaṁ ja̱jñatū̱ roda̍sī̱me rā̱ye de̱vī dhi̱ṣaṇā̍ dhāti de̱vam | adha̍ vā̱yuṁ ni̱yuta̍ḥ saścata̱ svā u̱ta śve̱taṁ vasu̍dhitiṁ nire̱ke ||
english: These two worlds, heaven and earth, were born for wealth; the divine Dhiṣaṇā sets the god for wealth. Then his own teams accompany Vāyu, and the white one, the holder of goods, in the distinction.

sanskrit: u̱cchann u̱ṣasa̍ḥ su̱dinā̍ ari̱prā u̱ru jyoti̍r vividu̱r dīdhyā̍nāḥ | gavya̍ṁ cid ū̱rvam u̱śijo̱ vi va̍vru̱s teṣā̱m anu̍ pra̱diva̍ḥ sasru̱r āpa̍ḥ ||
english: As Uṣas shines forth, pure on the bright days, the meditating ones have found the wide light. Even the cowpen the Uśijs have opened wide; for them the waters have flowed onward from day to day.

sanskrit: te sa̱tyena̱ mana̍sā̱ dīdhyā̍nā̱ḥ svena̍ yu̱ktāsa̱ḥ kratu̍nā vahanti | indra̍vāyū vīra̱vāha̱ṁ ratha̍ṁ vām īśā̱nayo̍r a̱bhi pṛkṣa̍ḥ sacante ||
english: They, meditating with a truthful mind and yoked with their own will, drive onward. The refreshments accompany your chariot that carries heroes, O Indra and Vāyu, you two lords.

sanskrit: ī̱śā̱nāso̱ ye dadha̍te̱ sva̍r ṇo̱ gobhi̱r aśve̍bhi̱r vasu̍bhi̱r hira̍ṇyaiḥ | indra̍vāyū sū̱rayo̱ viśva̱m āyu̱r arva̍dbhir vī̱raiḥ pṛta̍nāsu sahyuḥ ||
english: Those who are lords and who establish for us the sun with cows, horses, goods, and gold — may the wise lords prevail for Indra and Vāyu with a full span of life, with steeds and heroes in battles.

sanskrit: arva̍nto̱ na śrava̍so̱ bhikṣa̍māṇā indravā̱yū su̍ṣṭu̱tibhi̱r vasi̍ṣṭhāḥ ||  vā̱ja̱yanta̱ḥ sv ava̍se huvema yū̱yam pā̍ta sva̱stibhi̱ḥ sadā̍ naḥ ||
english: Like coursing steeds seeking fame, the Vasiṣṭhas invoke Indra and Vāyu with fine praises. Striving for the prize, we call upon you for your own protection. Preserve us evermore with your blessings.
